title: Decoded lengths exceed allocation or write bounds
preconditions: An input-derived length may reach allocation or copying before arithmetic and capacity checks
dangerous_transitions: An input-derived length may reach allocation or copying before arithmetic and capacity checks
sink_semantics: length decoding, size arithmetic, allocation and bounded writes
counterevidence: Checked arithmetic and capacity validation dominate every allocation and write using the decoded size.
Only trusted producers within the same security boundary can reach the decoder, and untrusted principals cannot alter the decoded data.
